method: Ripped off one of its horns and drove it into the monster's side
Disintegrated with Riptide during the Battle of the Williamsburg Bridge
Slew the Minotaur inside the Labyrinth using his bare hands and sword
Decapitated using Riptide while viewing her reflection in a glass gazing ball
Decapitated with an adamantine harpe while watching her through a polished bronze shield mirror
Sliced with Riptide in the Metropolitan Museum gallery when she attacked as Mrs. Dodds
Forced a block of lead on a spear point into the Chimera's flaming mouth, suffocating it
Tricked onto his own waterbed, bound with brass clamps, and decapitated with Riptide
Wrestled Cerberus into submission barehanded and captured him for his Twelfth Labor
Tricked onto his own bed and chopped off his head and feet to fit the frame
Blinded in his single eye using a hot sharpened wooden olive stake after intoxicating him
Defeated Polyphemus in single combat, held Riptide to his eye, and spared his life before escaping with the Fleece
Blasted with full cannon volleys from the CSS Birmingham steamship at Monster Donut
Cut off heads while Iolaus cauterized the necks, then buried the golden head under a boulder
Driven off the cliff into the sea by a barrage of silver arrows from Zoë and the Hunters
Fed freeze-dried astronaut ice cream inside the Air and Space Museum to force its mouth open, exposing its soft interior to silver arrows
Fired silver arrows into its exposed open mouth while Percy distracted it with space food
Strangled the lion with his bare hands and skinned it using its own razor-sharp claw
Lured the giant boar onto a frozen lake in New Mexico, causing it to crash through the ice and become trapped
Chased the boar into heavy snow drifts on Mount Erymanthos, trapped it in a net, and carried it alive to Eurystheus
Shot Ladon over the garden wall with arrows dipped in Hydra venom to retrieve the Golden Apples
Crushed Kampê under a relentless barrage of hundreds of giant boulders in the Labyrinth courtyard
Stabbed Kelli from behind with her Celestial Bronze dagger during the attack at Goode High School
Shot a single arrow guided by the West Wind that pierced all three of Geryon's hearts simultaneously
Shot Geryon through all three of his chests with an arrow dipped in Hydra blood
Drove an electric spear straight into the Drakon's unarmored eye while riding her war chariot
Strangled Cacus to death in his Aventine cavern after the giant stole Geryon's red cattle
